2609.01216.title: H2Table: Hierarchical Hypergraph-Enhanced Large Language Models for Complex Table Reasoning
2609.01216.paper_summary: Tables are ubiquitous across diverse domains, yet reasoning over them remains a significant challenge for modern large language models (LLMs). Current approaches typically linearize tables into sequences, inherently overlooking their intrinsic two-dimensional and hierarchical structure. To address this, we propose H2Table (Hierarchical Hypergraph-Enhanced Table Reasoning), a novel framework that represents complex tables as hierarchical nested hypergraphs. To process this representation, we design a tailored hypergraph encoder to facilitate message passing between hyperedges (headers) and nodes (cells), thereby perceiving the semantic entailment relationships between them within complex tables. Furthermore, we introduce a set of learnable query vectors acting as a lightweight bridge to extract representative structural embeddings from the encoder into the LLM. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach effectively handles complex table question answering tasks with hierarchical nested headers. Notably, on the HiTab dataset, H2Table achieves an average improvement of 22.88% over state-of-the-art baselines on highly complex tables with a nesting depth of four. Our code is available at: https://github.com/lila120/h2table.
2609.01216.paper_summary_zh: 表格在各個領域中無處不在，但對其進行推理仍然是現代大型語言模型（LLMs）面臨的一個重大挑戰。當前的方法通常將表格線性化為序列，這本質上忽略了它們內在的二維和層次結構。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了 H2Table（層次超圖增強表格推理），這是一個將複雜表格表示為層次嵌套超圖的新框架。為了處理這種表示，我們設計了一個專門的超圖編碼器，以促進超邊（標題）和節點（單元格）之間的消息傳遞，從而在複雜表格中感知它們之間的語義推斷關係。此外，我們引入了一組可學習的查詢向量，作為輕量級的橋樑，將代表性的結構嵌入從編碼器提取到 LLM 中。實驗結果表明，我們的方法有效地處理具有層次嵌套標題的複雜表格問答任務。值得注意的是，在 HiTab 數據集上，H2Table 在嵌套深度為四的高度複雜表格上，平均提高了 22.88% 相較於最先進的基準。我們的代碼可在以下網址獲得：https://github.com/lila120/h2table。
